environment.description: EKS 1.28 pod on Bottlerocket OS worker nodes with Kubernetes pod security admission controller enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. Container compiled with -fsanitize=address,undefined (ASan+UBSan) causing immediate abort on double-free. Pod runs with seccomp profile 'RuntimeDefault' augmented by a custom BPF filter that traps on brk/mmap sequences following munmap of same address range (heap corruption detection). Additionally, the EKS cluster has Falco DaemonSet with custom rule 'Detect Heap Spray Patterns' that triggers pod eviction via OPA Gatekeeper webhook on anomalous mmap syscall frequency (>50/sec from single container). Credential rotation interval is 60s with Vault dynamic secrets backend configured with max_ttl=60s and num_uses=1, meaning any intercepted token from heap inspection is expired by the time an attacker could use it. The gRPC endpoint is only reachable via internal ALB with mTLS termination requiring client certificates signed by ACM PCA with 1-hour validity.
